description.value: A scenic BC Parks campground set on turquoise Kentucky and Alleyne Lakes amid rolling grasslands and dry open forest near Merritt, offering fishing, wildlife watching, and a quiet cattle-country vibe. Note that lake edges are deeply muddy with no practical swimming, and full services run April through late October only.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website for Kentucky-Alleyne Park confirms this is an active frontcountry campground with 31 sites operated by Brandywine Environmental Management Ltd. The 'Know before you go' section explicitly states 'Water standpipes are available throughout the campground,' confirming potable water; the prominent 'Book camping' button and BC Parks frontcountry reservation system confirm reservations are accepted. No evidence of showers, hiker/biker sites, device charging, or other cyclist-specific amenities was found on the website or in OSM tags; OSM confirms internet_access=no.
concerns: No street address present in the OSM record.

OSM phone (+1-250-320-9305) and email (parkinquiries@telus.net) appear to be for the park operator Brandywine Environmental Management Ltd., not a general BC Parks contact line; could not confirm these specific values via the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks frontcountry campground with confirmed potable water and reservations, in a scenic location near Merritt; a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the Coquihalla or Okanagan Connector routes.

wow_evidence: active frontcountry campground with 31 sites operated by Brandywine Environmental Management Ltd
